basis.label: Compressors (for refrigeration, 15kw and above)
basis.note: Printed page 52. Refrigeration compressors 15 kW and above (ice plant compressors are in this class). Refrigeration category. Printed DV 10%, SL 7%. Tax depreciation lives set by the Commissioner of Inland Revenue for New Zealand income tax, not engineering or asset-management lives; they are banded and often short (e.g. reticulation piping 25 years). The July 2021 edition was the newest PDF reachable; the online Depreciation Rate Finder may hold later determinations.
